purpose: Independently inspect a created project body using deterministic structural, exact-text, and earlier-receipt content-digest checks without executing generated code.

properties.path: existing project directory, absolute or relative to the machine root
properties.checks: optional deterministic checks: file-exists, file-absent, nonempty, contains, not-contains, line-count, byte-size, sha256, json-valid, json-value, file-set, python-compile, html-local-links, css-local-links, javascript-local-imports
properties.expected_files: optional mapping of project-relative paths to exact expected UTF-8 text
properties.expected_file_digests: optional mapping of project-relative paths to SHA-256 content digests from an earlier creation receipt

relationships: rechecks file SHA-256 observations emitted by direct, templated, or organ-based creation receipts

anatomy_refs.basis: This live capability emits a bounded deterministic validation report containing pass state, performed checks, observed files, and explicit limitations.

limitations: every project JSON file is parser-validated automatically, but schema and semantic correctness require separate checks
every project receives a no-symlink boundary check before its regular file body is read
static-web verification checks local HTML src/href, CSS url/import, and JavaScript module references but is not a complete parser or browser test
bare JavaScript package imports and explicit external URLs are labeled external and are not fetched or claimed as verified
content digests prove byte identity against the supplied earlier receipt, not semantic correctness
does not substitute for browser visual/interaction testing
